# Zen Mesh — Webhook Operations

Version: 1.0.0
Last-Updated: 2026-05-25
Product: Zen Mesh — webhook ingestion, validation, delivery visibility, and security operations across Stripe, GitHub, and custom webhooks

Zen helps teams receive, validate, observe, and operate webhooks across Stripe, GitHub, and custom sources, with a planned expansion path to Shopify, Twilio, GitLab, Alipay, and similar providers. Current readiness: DEMO (local/mock/sandbox only, not customer-ready or production-live).
